node.statement: Induction step, with dependencies explicit: suppose a_{2^k}>=r_+(e). Node 1.3.1, applied with n=2^k, gives a_{2^{k+1}}>=a_{2^k}/2. Node 1.1 gives r_+(e)>=1-C_diag*e and C_diag*e<=1/2, hence a_{2^{k+1}}>=r_+(e)/2>=(1-C_diag*e)/2>=1/4>r_-(e), the final strict inequality again being node 1.1. Applying node 1.2 at n=2^{k+1}, its alternative a_{2^{k+1}}<=r_-(e) is impossible, so a_{2^{k+1}}>=r_+(e).
